items.title: Alignment Whack-a-Mole : Finetuning Activates Verbatim Recall of Copyrighted Books in Large Language Models
items.title_zh: 打地鼠式对齐：微调激活大模型对受版权书籍的逐字记忆
items.summary: When models were finetuned to turn plot summaries into full-length text, GPT-4o, Gemini-2.5-Pro and DeepSeek-V3.1 reproduced 85-90% of books held out from training in some cases, with individual verbatim passages longer than 460 words. The authors report the effect generalizes across authors and argue it shows model weights store copies of copyrighted works, undermining a premise of recent fair use rulings.

items.title: Determinism in the Undetermined: Deterministic Output in Charge-Conserving Continuous-Time Neuromorphic Systems with Temporal Stochasticity
items.title_zh: 未定之中的确定性：时间随机性下电荷守恒连续时间神经形态系统的确定性输出
items.summary: The authors develop a continuous-time framework for spiking neural networks that couples charge conservation with minimal neuron-level constraints, so the terminal state depends only on aggregate input charge and stays invariant to temporal stochasticity. They prove the mapping is strictly invariant to spike timing in acyclic networks and establish an exact correspondence between these charge-conserving SNNs and quantized artificial neural networks.

items.title: Tabular LLMs for Interpretable Few-Shot Alzheimer's Disease Prediction with Multimodal Biomedical Data
items.title_zh: 面向阿尔茨海默病少样本可解释预测的多模态表格 LLM
items.summary: TAP-GPT is a tabular LLM built on TableGPT2 and fine-tuned for few-shot Alzheimer's disease classification from tabular prompts; across four ADNI-derived datasets it improved on its backbone and beat traditional machine-learning baselines in few-shot settings while staying stable under missing data without imputation.

items.title: FedAgain: A Trust-Based and Robust Federated Learning Strategy for an Automated Kidney Stone Identification in Ureteroscopy
items.title_zh: FedAgain：面向输尿管镜肾结石自动识别的可信鲁棒联邦学习策略
items.summary: The paper introduces FedAgain, a federated learning strategy with a dual trust mechanism that weights client contributions by benchmark reliability and model divergence to limit noisy or adversarial updates. Experiments across five datasets, including multi-institutional kidney stone datasets plus MNIST and CIFAR-10, show it outperforms standard federated learning baselines under non-IID and corrupted-client conditions.

items.title: When Negation Is a Geometry Problem in Vision-Language Models
items.title_zh: 当否定成为视觉语言模型中的几何问题
items.summary: The paper examines why CLIP-style vision-language embedding models fail at negation, critiques retrieval-based evaluation, and uses multimodal LLM judges to assess negation understanding. It finds evidence of a negation direction in CLIP embedding space that can be manipulated at test time through representation engineering without fine-tuning.

items.title: Uncertainty-Aware Knowledge Distillation for Multimodal Large Language Models
items.title_zh: 面向多模态大语言模型的不确定性感知知识蒸馏
items.summary: The paper proposes Beta-weighted Knowledge Distillation (Beta-KD), an uncertainty-aware framework that adaptively modulates how much a student relies on teacher guidance from a Bayesian perspective; experiments on multimodal VQA benchmarks show it outperforms existing distillation methods.

items.title: From Noise to Signal: When Outliers Seed New Topics
items.title_zh: 从噪声到信号：离群点如何孕育新主题
items.summary: The authors introduce a temporal taxonomy of news-document trajectories that separates anticipatory outliers from documents that reinforce existing topics or remain isolated, implemented with document embeddings from eleven language models and evaluated on the French HydroNewsFr corpus.
